edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to the immutable _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
releaseStartTime_ is rounded down to a day boundary and stored in _releaseStartTime.
releaseStartTime_ is the base used to compute _releaseEndTime.
daysOfTimelock_ is added to the start time to derive _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY converts daysOfTimelock_ into seconds for _releaseEndTime.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY is used in releasedBalance for passedDays and totalDays.
block.timestamp is required to be before _releaseEndTime, making the release window timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp directly determines how much balance is released in releasedBalance.
terminate truncates block.timestamp to a day boundary when resetting _releaseEndTime.
_totalBenefit is reset to releasedBalance() in terminate, which depends on block.timestamp.
_releaseStartTime is read to compute elapsed vesting time.
_releaseEndTime is read to bound the vesting window.
_totalBenefit is read to scale the vested amount.
passedDays feeds the vested amount computation.
totalDays is the denominator of the vested amount computation.
releasedBalance performs multiplication and division that may overflow or round down.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance to derive its result.
_totalBenefit is used as the minuend in unreleasedBalance.
unreleasedBalance performs a subtraction that could underflow if released exceeds total.
withdraw calls releasedBalance to compute the withdrawable amount.
_withdrawedBalance is read and compared against releasedBalance in withdraw.
_token is used for balanceOf and the transfer inside withdraw.
withdraw increments _withdrawedBalance before transferring.
withdraw computes the local amount as releasedBalance minus _withdrawedBalance.
releasedBalance result feeds the local amount in withdraw.
withdraw executes the external token transfer unsafe operation.
_beneficiary is the recipient of the transfer in withdraw.
_token is the contract whose safeTransfer is invoked in withdraw.
Local amount is the value transferred to the beneficiary.
A malicious ERC20 implementation could re-enter withdraw during the external transfer callback.
terminate calls releasedBalance to snapshot the vested amount.
terminate overwrites _totalBenefit with the current released balance.
terminate resets _releaseEndTime to the current day boundary.
terminate sets _isTerminated to true.
terminate subtracts the still-vested amount from the contract token balance.
terminate stores the residual balance in amountToWithdraw.
owner() is the recipient of the residual tokens in terminate.
_token is the contract whose safeTransfer is invoked in terminate.
amountToWithdraw is the value transferred to the owner.
terminate executes the external token transfer unsafe operation.
An external token callback during terminate's transfer could re-enter the contract.
The onlyOwner modifier on terminate checks owner() before execution.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) is compared against owner() for the onlyOwner guard.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, the caller identity input.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_setOwner writes the new value into _owner.
_setOwner caches the previous owner in the oldOwner local variable.
